# HTML to Image

HTML to Image is a service that converts HTML and CSS into images or captures screenshots of web pages.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/html-to-image/.

## Actions

- **Check HTML-to-Image Account Usage** (read-only): Retrieve account usage statistics including hourly, daily, and monthly image creation counts.
- **Convert HTML to Image**: Convert HTML content into an image.
- **Get HTML to Image** (read-only): Retrieve a generated image by its ID.
